task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. Your first objective is to try to go north. If you can get through with that, make an effort to venture east. And then, open the gate. Then, take a trip east. With that done, travel north. Then, lift the worm from the floor of the bedroom. Got that? Good!
description:
You find yourself in an office. A standard one.



There is an open gateway leading north. You need an unblocked exit? You should try going east. There is an unguarded exit to the south.

thought: I should go north through the open gateway as the first step of the objective.
feedback:
You've just walked into a cookery.

Oh wow! Is that what I think it is? It is! It's a shelf. The shelf is standard. But there isn't a thing on it. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it? You can make out a rack. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of garbage. You can see a counter. The counter is standard. The counter appears to be empty.

There is an open hatch leading east. There is an open gateway leading south.
